title: Your provider workspace
desc: Maintain the services and evidence Mission Owners use to prepare and sustain their ATO packages.

title: Service offerings
desc: Keep each service, environment, and responsibility model clearly defined.

title: Create a service offering
desc: Start with the service identity. Add authorization sources and publish reviewed capabilities afterward.

title: Azure IL5 · Shared services
desc: Manage the source-backed service baseline that customers can apply to their systems.

title: Authorizations & sources
desc: Review what the documents actually say before they support a published service release.

title: Add source material
desc: Attach documents to this offering. SPIN proposes records for review before anything reaches customers.

title: Review package analysis
desc: Resolve source exceptions, then review the proposed records by their purpose.

title: Review an extracted implementation
desc: Compare the proposal with its source, confirm customer duties, and retain your rationale.

title: Recorded authorization
desc: Inspect the external decision and the exact boundary it references.

title: Services & scope
desc: Define what your service provides and where customer use is eligible.

title: Propose a scope update
desc: Review the next version without altering the scope used by existing releases.

title: Capabilities & responsibilities
desc: Publish reusable security implementations with a clear provider/customer split.

title: Centralized audit collection
desc: Review the implementation, supporting evidence, and customer duties as one service contract.

title: Review and publish release 1.3
desc: Confirm the exact service implementation changes and the information customers will receive.

title: Evidence & findings
desc: Maintain usable evidence and make service weaknesses visible to the right reviewers.

title: Shared-services assessment summary
desc: Review exactly what customers can access and include in their system package.

title: Logging evidence collection delay
desc: Track provider remediation and customer impact without duplicating the mission’s risk decision.

title: Mission systems
desc: See exactly which service scopes and releases your customers use.

title: Assign service scope
desc: Record what a customer can associate with its system. This does not provision cloud access.

title: Harbor Logistics
desc: Track the service relationship while preserving the Mission Owner’s control over their system.

title: Changes requiring attention
desc: Understand service changes, affected customers, and the action each owner needs to take.

title: Review the retention change
desc: Trace the proposed service change to customer duties and system documentation.

title: Service monitoring
desc: Monitor source freshness and shared-service changes, then route meaningful impacts to customer systems.

title: Configure a monitoring rule
desc: Define the condition, scope, and response so the rule can produce an actionable review.

title: Provider administration
desc: Manage the people and connections used to maintain provider records.

title: Provider audit history
desc: Follow retained changes, source reviews, publication, and customer-access decisions.

title: Environment & hosting
desc: Associate this mission system with the provider service it actually uses.

title: Applied capabilities
desc: Select a provider release and inspect the implementation and customer work before applying it.

title: Responsibilities
desc: Complete the work that remains with the mission after provider capabilities are applied.

title: Provider evidence in this system
desc: See usable artifacts, controlled references, and the gaps that still need attention.

title: Document previews
desc: Review how provider records and mission work combine in the system package.

title: ATO package readiness
desc: Resolve document and evidence gaps before preparing a package for the receiving eMASS workflow.

title: Review provider change impact
desc: Determine what the provider’s retention change means for this mission system.

title: Coverage & health
desc: Monitor this system’s resources and adopted provider services with clear source-health status.

title: Set up your provider workspace
desc: Create the service workspace and optionally add source material. Review extracted records later in the portal.

title: Your workspace is ready
desc: Continue into the portal to review source analysis when you are ready.
